source.origin: Seller-published social creative, Owner-selected (same theme as REF-07)
source.rights: Third-party seller artwork selected by the Owner as calibration evidence. Never reproduce, never pass to a generator as image input, never publish. Only the transferable principles leave this record.

classification.event_product_type: Themed auction teaser (no date or logistics shown)

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Seller name top-centre → MANCAVE (navy distressed) / AUCTION (red distressed) with gold stars → twelve objects fill everything else. No date, time, URL or CTA.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Bronze eagle, bison mount, pair of axis-hide chairs, black limousine, Cartier watch, Leica camera, yellow MG convertible, bulldozer, pontoon boat, golf cart, handwritten letters, gold coin. Extracted; dense; overlapping; several cropped at the edges; scale deliberately non-literal (the watch is as large as a car).
visual_read.composition_style: Full-canvas catalogue spread on white with the title embedded among the objects. A teaser: the merchandise IS the message.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Distressed varsity caps in navy and red with gold stars; seller name and descriptor in serif caps above.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller name leads; no URL anywhere.
visual_read.footer_treatment: None; objects run to the bottom edge.

strongest_attributes: Pure merchandise teaser — the Owner approves an ad with zero event information
Vehicles, heavy equipment, a boat and a golf cart: the strongest breadth evidence in the library (not antiques-only)
Full-canvas occupancy; the title lives inside the merchandise
Distressed title type carries the theme without any tagline
transferable_lessons: A LAUNCH-wave teaser may omit date/time entirely; the event details follow in later creative (feeds the Wave model)
Breadth: tools, vehicles, equipment and outdoor property are legitimate hero merchandise
Non-literal scale is acceptable in the scatter family when it misrepresents no lot
Merchandise share can reach ~80% with two copy blocks
do_not_generalize: Distressed varsity typography, red/navy/gold — theme and seller identity
No URL: an Advantage.Bid creative always carries the navy footer wordmark
Letters/documents shown as merchandise are event-specific

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Seller name and title only. Nothing else is needed for a teaser.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: Shows the budget floor: presenter + title + footer is a complete ad.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Spread; objects fill space by silhouette, not by world logic.
composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: Not claimed; vehicles and boat float on white.
composition_assessment.depth: Overlaps everywhere, none meaning 'in front of' — decorative by the 3M definition, accepted here because no room is implied.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Silhouette-driven: vehicles large, small objects enlarged for legibility.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Letters, bulldozer, boat, golf cart and coin cropped at the edges; nothing identifying lost.

avoid_for: families where the gravity rule is locked

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
